items: Which is the last surah of the Quran in the standard order of the Mushaf?
An-Nas, with 6 verses, is the 114th and last surah.
Which surah with only 3 verses is known as the shortest surah by wording?
Al-Kawthar has 3 verses and is the shortest surah by number of words.
In which blessed night was the Quran first revealed?
The Quran began to be revealed in the Night of Power in the month of Ramadan.
Under which caliph was the Quran first collected into a single written volume?
The Quran was first compiled into one copy in the time of Abu Bakr.
Under which caliph were standard copies of the Quran made and sent to the main Muslim cities?
Uthman had copies made from the compiled text and sent them to the major centres.
Which is the second surah of the Quran?
Al-Baqarah follows Al-Fatihah and is the longest surah.
Which basic belief does Surah Al-Ikhlas emphasise?
Al-Ikhlas declares that God is One, Eternal, and without child or equal.
Which surah, recited in every unit of prayer, is called 'The Opening of the Book'?
Al-Fatihah is recited in every unit of the prayer.
In which surah is Ayat al-Kursi (verse 255) found?
Ayat al-Kursi is verse 255 of Surah Al-Baqarah.
How many parts (juz') is the Quran divided into?
The Quran is divided into 30 equal parts called juz'.
Which prophet has a surah named after him among the following?
Surah Yunus is the 10th surah; the other three prophets have no surah named after them.
How many verses does Surah Al-Fatihah have?
Which angel brought revelation to the Prophet Muhammad (peace be upon him)?
Jibril is the angel entrusted with delivering revelation.
The longest verse of the Quran, the verse on debt contracts, is in which surah?
The verse on documenting debts is the longest verse of the Quran.
Which two surahs at the end of the Quran teach seeking refuge in God?
Al-Falaq and An-Nas are called al-Mu'awwidhatayn, the two surahs of refuge.
Which surah tells a single story and calls it 'the best of stories'?
Surah Yusuf recounts the story of Prophet Yusuf from beginning to end.
What are the surahs revealed in Mecca before the Hijrah called?
Surahs revealed before the Hijrah are called Makki; those after are called Madani.
What are the surahs revealed after the Hijrah called?
Madani surahs were revealed in Medina after the Hijrah.
Which surah is named after the bee and speaks of its inspiration and the healing it provides?
In which surah does a second Bismillah appear inside the text itself (verse 30)?
The letter of Sulayman to the Queen of Sheba begins with 'In the name of God' in verse 30.
Which companion is the only one mentioned by name in the Quran?
Zayd ibn Harithah is the only companion named in the Quran.
According to Surah Al-Qadr, the Night of Power is better than what?
Surah Al-Qadr says the Night of Power is better than a thousand months.
In which surah is the story of the People of the Cave told?
Surah Al-Kahf tells the story of the youth who slept in the cave.
Which surah describes people on the Day of Judgement as 'scattered moths'?
Al-Qari'ah describes the terrors of the Day of Judgement.
Which surah begins by swearing by time and names the qualities of the believers who are not at loss?
Al-'Asr is only three verses long and sums up the way to success.
Which surah tells how Abraha's army that came to destroy the Kaaba was destroyed?
Al-Fil recounts the Year of the Elephant.
Which surah opens by saying angels are made messengers with two, three or four wings?
The first verse of Surah Fatir mentions angels with wings in twos, threes and fours.
Which wise man in the Quran advises his son not to associate partners with God and to pray?
Surah Luqman records the advice of Luqman to his son.
In which surah is 'Which of the favours of your Lord will you deny?' repeated 31 times?
Surah Ar-Rahman repeats this refrain 31 times.
Which surah exposes the hypocrites for their lying and double standards?
Al-Munafiqun describes the hypocrites of Medina.
Which surah begins by addressing the Prophet as 'You who are wrapped up' and tells him to rise and warn?
Al-Muddaththir begins with 'O you who is covered, arise and warn'.
Which surah discusses the Battle of Uhud and the test of the believers?
Surah Al Imran contains the account of Uhud.
Which surah answers those who mocked the Prophet as 'cut off' by saying the one cut off is the one who hates him?
Al-Kawthar declares that the one who hates the Prophet is the one cut off.
Which surah says the earth will be shaken with a mighty quake and will bring out its burdens?
Az-Zalzalah describes the Day of Judgement quake.
Which surah explains the shares of inheritance in the most detail?
An-Nisa sets out the Islamic rules of inheritance.
In which surah are the three companions who stayed behind from the Tabuk expedition and were forgiven mentioned?
At-Tawbah mentions the three who repented sincerely and were forgiven.
Which surah is named 'Iron' and speaks of its great strength and benefits?
Al-Hadid says God sent down iron, in which is great might and benefits.
Which surah divides people on the Day of Judgement into three groups according to their deeds?
Al-Waqi'ah describes the companions of the right, of the left, and the foremost.
Which surah announces the ruin of Abu Lahab, the Prophet's enemy?
Al-Masad (also Tabbat) says the hands of Abu Lahab will perish.
How many surahs begin with the letters Ha-Mim (the 'Hawamim' surahs)?
There are seven Ha-Mim surahs from Ghafir to Al-Ahqaf.
How many verses does Surah Yusuf have?
Which surah describes the believers' patience during the Battle of the Trench against the allied armies?
Al-Ahzab recounts the siege of Medina by the confederate armies.
Which surah says you will find no change in God's way (sunnatullah)?
Fatir 43 states that you will never find any change in God's way.
Which surah gives rulings about the spoils of the Battle of Badr and the ransom of prisoners?
Al-Anfal deals with the spoils of war after Badr.
Which surah tells the story of the People of the Trench, where believers were thrown into fire?
Al-Buruj condemns those who burned the believers in trenches.
In which surah is the Prophet exonerated of the slander against Aisha, mother of the believers?
Surah An-Nur announces the innocence of Aisha.
What name does the Quran give to the day of Badr, the day the criterion between truth and falsehood was shown?
The day of Badr is called Yawm al-Furqan, the day of discrimination.
